source:
Make a simple 3D endless runner. Keep it simple - do NOT do prompt
enhancement or a big requirements write-up, and don't expand the scope. I
just want one small, polished, ~5-minute playable game, nothing more.

- Fully 3D (render a real WebGL scene). Works on mobile, touch and mouse,
 in both portrait and landscape.
- Third-person camera behind and slightly above the runner, looking down
 the track.
- The runner auto-runs forward; tap/swipe left-right to switch lanes,
 tap/swipe up to jump. Dodge obstacles and grab coins. Speed increases
 slowly over time.
- Crashing into an obstacle ends the run - show the run distance and coins
 with a Retry button.
- Save the player's best distance on the server and show it in the HUD.

That's the whole game. No shops, no extra modes, no upgrade systems - just
the core run loop, made to feel good.

answers.ask: No setting was given - should the track read as city, desert, neon, or deliberately abstract?
answers.answer: Use a deliberately abstract, clean arcade runner look so the core movement and obstacles stay readable.

answers.ask: The track is endless, so only a chunk can be framed - is a few-hundred-stud segment the right unit to draw?
answers.answer: Yes, use a few-hundred-stud visible/recycled track segment; that is enough for this small endless runner.

scene_prompt: Create a simple fully 3D endless runner map with a deliberately abstract, clean arcade look. Frame a few-hundred-stud visible and recycled track segment from a third-person camera behind and slightly above the runner, looking forward down the track. The track has clear parallel lanes, with obstacles and collectible coins placed ahead along the route; keep the surroundings minimal so the movement path remains readable.
